## 中文说明

让 dsh 智能体做机械设计：编写 CadQuery 参数化建模代码（3D 零件）或 ezdxf 代码（2D 工程图）→ 校验几何 → 渲染预览 → 导出制造格式（STEP/IGES/STL/3MF/DXF）。

- **安装前置**：Python 3.10+；三维装 `pip install cadquery`，二维制图装 `pip install ezdxf matplotlib`（按需二选一或都装），PNG 预览用 `pip install matplotlib`
- **安装插件**：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad-design`，然后 `dsh web` 启动。注意必须显式指定 `--profile`，且目标 profile 要带有界面 bundle——新自定义 profile 默认只含 dsh-base（无界面、静默运行）；启动用 `dsh --profile <名字>`，不要带 `web` 参数。装完先用 `cad_doctor` 做环境自检。（注意区分：npm 上另有 LAU-MARS 的 [`dsh-cad`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)——CAD 查看器插件，与本包互补：本包负责建模出图，它负责在 Web 界面里看图）
- **后端架构**：adapter 注册表 + 能力路由。自带 CadQuery（OpenCASCADE 内核，原生 STEP）和 ezdxf（2D DXF，内置生产验证的修复器：TEXT 对齐点补齐、CJK 字体预览重映射、白底 ACI7 处理）；OpenSCAD、FreeCAD 在路线图上；商业 CAD（SolidWorks/NX/CATIA/AutoCAD/中望/浩辰）通过中性格式（STEP/IGES/DXF）互操作，进程内桥接预留为独立插件包
- **路由与开关**：工具按代码 import 自动识别后端（`import ezdxf` → 二维），也可用 `backend` 参数强制；`backendPriority` 控制多后端优先级；`cadquery.enabled` / `ezdxf.enabled` 可分别关闭；`pythonPath` / `DSH_CAD_PYTHON` 指定解释器
- **注意**：工具会在本机执行 Python 代码（参数化 CAD 的工作方式），共享部署请配合 dsh 的 `tools/pre-execute` 权限门禁

plugins.description: 把电脑串口接进 DeepSeek Harness——让 AI 能看见 Arduino/STM32/ESP32 的运行时输出（面板 + AI 工具双通道）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-serial（面板 + AI 工具双通道）

把电脑的串口接进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）——
**让 AI 能看见 Arduino / STM32 / ESP32 / 51 单片机的运行时输出。**

## 两条通道，如下所示

| 通道 | 主用户 | 入口 |  作用  |
|---|---|---|---|
| 悬浮球面板 | 人 | 右下角悬浮球（可拖动移位，点击开面板） | 选口连接、实时看日志、演示模式、手动发送、复制日志 |
| AI 工具 | AI | 对话框里直接说 | `serial_list_ports` 列串口 / `serial_read` 读串口并自动分析 |

两条通道**共用同一个串口服务实例**——面板开着的口，AI 工具直接从它的实时缓冲取数据，
不会出现"同一 COM 口被抢"的冲突（Windows 上同一串口不能被两个程序同时打开）。

## 原理

```
单片机跑程序 ──UART──▶ USB转串口芯片(CH340) ──USB──▶ 操作系统 COM 口 ──▶ 本插件 ──▶ 面板 / AI
└────────────── 硬件的世界，插件的代码从 COM 口右边才开始 ──────────────┘
```

- UART 协议、电平、时序——全部由硬件和 `serialport` 库封装，插件只管理"读已解好的字节流"
- 插件无构建：纯 JS 源码即运行产物（Host 半 `lib/`，Browser 半 `client/`）

## 文件结构

```
dsh-serial/
├── package.json          # 包配置：dsh.bundle.patch（装入声明）+ dsh.client（浏览器端声明）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 安装补丁：把插件插入 profile 的插件层
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # 入口：注册串口服务 + 两个 AI 工具 + 挂载面板路由
│   ├── service.js        # 串口服务引擎（列口/开关/读/写/演示模式，环形缓冲）
│   └── routes.js         # 面板数据通道：HTTP 路由 /dsh-serial/api/*（官方 webServer 扩展点）
├── client/
│   └── client.js         # Browser 半：悬浮球面板（可拖拽 + 自适应定位，纯原生 DOM）
├── tools/
│   ├── serial-smoke.mjs       # 独立串口验证脚本（不依赖 dsh）
│   ├── mock-load-test.mjs     # Host 半模拟加载测试（工具注册/路由/安全）
│   └── client-load-test.mjs   # Browser 半行为测试（拖拽/定位/缩放，vm 模拟 DOM）
├── README.md
├── LICENSE                    # MIT
└── .gitignore
```

## 安装

```bash
# 1. 在本目录安装依赖（serialport）
npm install --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com

# 2. 装进 dsh 的 desktop profile（二选一）
# 方式 A（推荐）：官方 CLI
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本目录绝对路径>

# 方式 B：手动三件套
#   ① profiles/desktop/package.json 的 dependencies 加：
#        "dsh-serial": "link:<本目录绝对路径>"
#   ② profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml 追加：
#        - insert:
#            - id: dsh-serial
#              name: 'dsh-serial'
#   ③ 在 profiles/desktop 目录执行 pnpm install

# 3. 重启 dsh 桌面版
```

## 验证（三层实例，逐层加码）

**Level 0 · 不依赖 dsh（先验证最底层）**

```bash
node tools/serial-smoke.mjs                    # 应列出本机串口
node tools/serial-smoke.mjs COM3 9600 3000     # 插上板子后读取 3 秒
```

**Level 1 · 面板通道（无需硬件，使用插件演示模式）**

重启 dsh 后：界面右下角出现"串口"悬浮球 → 点开 → 点"演示模式" →
看到模拟数据（即模拟DHT11 温湿度 + HC-SR04 距离）每 0.8 秒滚动，证明面板链路通畅。

**Level 2 · AI 工具通道（无需硬件即可验证注册）**

在 dsh 新会话里对 AI 提出：

> 列一下我电脑上有哪些串口

预期：AI 调用 `serial_list_ports` 返回本机串口列表（蓝牙/虚拟口也算入）。

**Level 3 · 完整闭环（注意：需要板子完成验证）**

1. Arduino 烧一个每秒打印的程序（见下）
2. 对 AI 提出：`读一下 COM3 五秒，告诉我板子在打印什么`
3. 预期：AI 返回日志原样内容 + 自己的解读；如果此时面板正开着同一个口，工具会自动改用实时缓冲

```cpp
// Arduino 测试程序
void setup() {
  Serial.begin(9600);          // 波特率必须和读取时一致
}
void loop() {
  Serial.println("hello from board");
  delay(1000);
}
```

**Level 4 · 制造故障（体验"AI 诊断硬件"）**

把读取的波特率改成 115200（与程序的 9600 故意不一致），再让 AI 读取。
预期：AI 收到乱码，且主动提示"疑似波特率不匹配"——这属于 AI 看串口的实用价值之一。

## 降级设计（防御策略）

| 缺失的东西 | 后果 | 兜底 |
|---|---|---|
| `webServer` 服务（无 Web UI 的环境，如 headless） | 面板没有数据通道 | 工具通道照常工作，插件不崩 |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（defineTool 包装器） | 少一层参数校验 | 工具原样注册，功能不变 |
| `serialport` 库 | 真实串口不可用 | 演示模式可用，面板提示原因 |

## 已知边界

- 面板 UI 是原生 DOM 悬浮球（不碰 React/设置页 slot）——v0.2 再考虑升级进官方 slot
- 无构建流程：赢在改一行刷新即生效，输在没有类型检查（靠实测兜底）

## 更新记录

- **v0.1.6**（2026-10-10 夜）：**面板美化批次**（纯视觉层，功能逻辑零改动）——A 静奢玻璃（半透明磨砂 + 内高光 + 进场动画 + 连接成功描边闪绿）+ C 日志语义色（事件蓝/警告琥珀/错误红 + 新行淡入）+ **"信号喷鲸"品牌主题**（标题栏小鲸标记 + 日志空状态水印「监听中 · 等待设备输出…」+ 轻微浮动）；三态状态灯（灰/琥珀呼吸/绿光晕）；发送行 ❯ 提示符；小窗口防裁切（面板高度 78vh + 内容可滚动）；悬浮球维持经典波形款。
- **v0.1.5**（2026-10-10）：面板标题栏新增**关闭按钮**（面板遮挡悬浮球时也能关闭；点击球关闭保留，两种方式并存）；用法说明重写为**专业版**（使用说明 + 辅助功能两段，覆盖连接/异常自动提示/刷新/演示/发送/复制日志）。
- **v0.1.4**（2026-10-10）：功能健壮性批次——连接/重开/失败/停止**事件留痕**（面板与 AI 同一时间线）；**乱码双告警**（4KB 无换行 + 连续乱码行，限频）；`serial_read`"读 N 秒"改为**真实时间窗**；活动波特率只在打开成功后生效；start/stop **串行化**（防双击竞态）；关闭串口兜底超时；端口名大小写不敏感；日志游标越界自愈；面板重连失败状态复位、日志 DOM 上限、输入法回车修复、send 8KB 上限。
- **v0.1.3**（2026-10-10）：修复桌面版点「连接」报 403（`same-origin POST required`）——桌面版 Electron 代理会剥离 `origin/host` 等请求头，POST 同源校验改为「有则校验、无则放行」（与 dshmarket 同款实战验证规则）；反拒绝留痕便于诊断。
- **v0.1.2**（2026-10-10）：桌面版适配——悬浮球可拖拽（位置记忆）；面板改为贴球自适应定位（自动翻转 + 视口钳制 + 高度随窗口伸缩 + 宽度按视口比例），小窗口下不再溢出屏幕。
- **v0.1.1**（2026-10-08）：样式修复（白块按钮 → 品牌蓝）+ 整体放大；数据通道由 RPC 重构为 HTTP 路由（解决第三方插件 RPC 不可用的架构死路）。
- **v0.1.0**（2026-10-08）：初稿——面板 + AI 工具双通道打通，演示模式与真机（CH340/COM4）验证通过。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: Deterministic goal-completion gate for DSH: contract-first AC grammar, re-runs every verify command itself (zero model trust), binds verdicts to a tree digest, denies false completion on update_goal/update_task via tools/pre-execute. Ports goal-loop's judging face onto native Agent Teams + task board.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-goalloop-agentteams

**Deterministic goal-completion gate for DeepSeek Harness** — ports the *judging face* of the [goal-loop](https://github.com/samirliu/goal-loop) skill onto native **Agent Teams** + the **task board**, and drives the full agentic loop from one trigger.

Contract-first acceptance criteria, a gate that **re-runs every check itself** (zero model trust), verdicts bound to a tree digest, and a hard deny on false completion at `update_goal` / `agent_teams_update_task` / `team_task_update` via `tools/pre-execute`. The portable team-file protocol and dual-ledger bookkeeping from goal-loop are deliberately *not* ported — native Agent Teams is strictly stronger.

**Trigger the loop:** `/goal-loop-at <objective>` (or the `goal_loop_at` tool) writes the contract + round config, returns the loop protocol and suggested Agent Teams tasks derived from each AC. Iterate via `goal_gate_check` (score, trend, failedActions), claim completion only on GO.

## 中文简介

**dsh-goalloop-agentteams** 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的**确定性目标门控 + 目标闭环**插件：

- **判命面**：契约先行的 AC 文法，门控自己重跑每条 check（零模型参与），verdict 绑定文件树摘要（文件改动即作废过审结论），目标级假完成 2 次即 `BLOCKED` 等人——模型永远不能自我宣布完成。
- **闭环面**：`/goal-loop-at <目标>` 一条命令触发完整 agentic loop——写契约骨架 + 轮次预算（`loop.json`）+ 循环协议 + 从每条 AC 派生的 Agent Teams 建议任务；`goal_gate_check` 输出 `score`/趋势/`failedActions`，**score 不得回退**，NO-GO 的失败项直接变 repair 任务。
- **评估面**：`maximize` 按基线判定（`baseline: delta` 严格改善 / `abs` 不回退）、`judged` 以 probe 为确定性判官、`metric:` 正则提取指标、Goodhart 三防线（unverifiable ≠ passed / 判官缺失 / 基线未建）。
- **分级治理**：`update_goal` 完成声明永远硬拦；任务级声明按 `exit: strict|goal-only` 分级，多任务 Agent Teams 循环不会死锁。

完整中文文档见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

## Why / 为什么需要它

DSH already has two layers of completion judgement — but neither is a deterministic gate:

| Layer | Judges | Gap |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-agent-teams` quality kinds | Did each step follow its contract | `verify` commands are **not re-executed** by the runtime; `commandsRun` exit codes are member-supplied |
| `dsh-task-board` acceptance gate | Does it look right semantically | LLM A/B comparison (threshold 0.65) — and **every card can opt out** via `skipVerification` |

`dsh-goalloop-agentteams` is the hard floor underneath both: it re-runs every AC's `check` command itself, binds verdicts to a tree digest, and counts caught false-completes — two catches → `BLOCKED`. Deterministic gate = floor, LLM judge = semantic layer, quality kinds = step contract. Stacked, they close the loop.

## Contract grammar / 契约文法

```
objective: <one-line goal>
[exit: goal-only | strict]
AC-1 | <yes/no statement> | check: `<command>` | [probe: `<probe>`] | [metric: `<regex with one capture group>`] | [baseline: delta|abs] | expected: <spec>
AC-2 | ... | check: `...` | expected: exit=0
```

Spec = `exit=0` | `<op><number>` (`<=5`, `>0`, `=3`) | `maximize` | `judged`.
Every `check` must be a **named, failable command** — include the environment dependency, the empty case, the error path — or the gate degrades into a tautology.

- `[probe:]` is *verify-the-verifier* (R9): the probe runs first; a probe failure marks the AC `unverifiable` rather than `passed`. More than 1/3 unverifiable → the whole gate returns NO-GO.
- `[metric:]` extracts the metric value from stdout (one capture group). Without it the gate falls back to the last number in the output — write `metric:` whenever the output contains other numbers.
- `maximize` compares against the previous round's metric: `baseline: delta` requires strict improvement, `baseline: abs` (default) requires no regression. The first run has no baseline → `unverifiable` (run `goal_gate_check` once to establish it).
- `judged` uses the `probe` as a deterministic judge — the probe's exit code *is* the verdict. Without a probe, or when the judge command is missing (exit 127), `judged` is `unverifiable` (a broken verifier is not a failing verdict).
- Contract lives at `.goal-gate/goal.md` in the workspace root.

## Gate & interception / 门控与拦截

`goal_gate_check` re-runs every check itself:

- `rc=0` GO / `rc=2` NO-GO / `rc=3` BLOCKED / `rc=4` state error
- Output carries the optimization signal: `score` (passed/total), `round` / `maxRounds` / `remainingRounds`, `bestScore`, `regression` (score dropped below the high-water mark), `trend` (last 5 rounds), `failedActions` (per-AC repair list)
- Interception is mounted on `tools/pre-execute` with **claim scoping**: `update_goal(action:'complete')` (the goal-level claim) is *always* hard-gated against the full contract with the R1 false-complete counter. Task-level claims — `agent_teams_update_task(status:'completed')`, `team_task_update(action:'complete')`, legacy `update_task(status:'completed')` — follow the contract's `exit:` policy:
  - `exit: strict` (default): full-contract hard gate + strike (single work unit: task completion *is* goal completion)
  - `exit: goal-only` (what `goal_loop_at` writes): mid-loop task progress passes (step-level truth belongs to quality-kind contracts); GO binds a digest, NO-GO is recorded as `partialCompletes` only. Without this split, every multi-task team deadlocks: a member finishing its own task is denied because teammates' ACs are still failing
  - `BLOCKED` (two caught false goal-completes) freezes every completion claim

## Goal loop / 目标闭环（right loop · right eval · right metric）

`/goal-loop-at <objective>` (slash command) or `goal_loop_at` (tool) starts the loop:

1. writes the contract skeleton (placeholder checks are fail-closed `TODO-REPLACE-ME`) and `.goal-gate/loop.json` (`maxRounds`, default 8);
2. returns the loop protocol and suggested Agent Teams tasks derived from each AC;
3. every gate evaluation is appended to `.goal-gate/history.jsonl` (`ts/trigger/round/code/score/totals/failed ACs`) — the trajectory the loop optimizes against;
4. NO-GO → turn `failedActions` into repair tasks, re-check; never claim completion before GO. Two caught false-completes → `BLOCKED` (human). The round budget counts optimization iterations only (check / completion-claim evaluations) — goal-only milestone records don't consume it; budget exhausted → `roundsExhausted`, stop and escalate.

Self-optimization rule: `score` must not regress (`regression: true` → fix the regression first); `maximize` ACs with `baseline: delta` require strict metric improvement round over round.

**Loop driver fallback / 循环驱动兜底**: a resumed session may lack the `goal_gate_*` tools — drive the loop from any session via `bin/gate.mjs check --cwd <workspace>` (absolute-path node), same ledger, same output shape. **Eval hardening**: `preflight` flags fragile check commands (bare `node`/`python`, relative interpreters, tautology suspects) and `neverFailed` lists ACs that have never failed (suspected tautologies).

## Three hard constraints / 三条硬约束（实测所得）

From an ordering probe (`tools/pre-execute` waterfall semantics, real deny-return shape):

1. **Waterfall is first-registered-first-block.** Only the earliest registered layer's deny reason reaches the user; later layers are never called. So the reason must carry its own `code` (`[goal-gate:no-go]` / `verdict-stale` / `blocked`) — otherwise the user can't tell which layer blocked.
2. **`deny` and `throw` are different propagation mechanisms and must not be mixed.** `dsh-agent-teams`'s quality-gate rejects by `throw`ing, which blows through the waterfall and hands the caller an exception; the task board returns a structured `{kind:'deny'}`. This plugin always uses structured `deny` — never `throw` — so its error path stays distinct from quality-gate exceptions.
3. **Digest binding must be self-built.** DSH has no verdict↔file-tree binding anywhere (only state-key hashes). This plugin stores the digest and re-computes it before denying, so a passing verdict is voided automatically when the tree moves (R7).

## R7 digest caveat / R7 摘要的坑（已修）

If `treeDigest` walks the ledger directory, writing the ledger changes the digest → the gate spuriously invalidates its own verdicts and R1's false-complete counter never reaches 2. Fixed: the digest excludes `.goal-gate`, `node_modules`, `.git`.

## Interpreter constraint / 解释器约束

The DSH Host bundles Node 24.21.0 (`runtime/primary-runtime/depen

plugins.description: Godot 工程开发工作流的本地 DSH 插件：常驻注入精简核心（不占 AGENTS.md 字节预算），完整版按需加载为 godot-workflow 技能
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-godot-workflow

把 `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` 里的 **Godot 工程开发工作流**做成本地 DSH 插件。

## 为什么

原来的做法把工作流放在 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`，它和项目链一起受 **65536 字节预算**约束，
且规则的语义是"**超预算时最宽泛的文件先被丢弃**" —— 也就是说工作流随时可能被
`ADD/AGENTS.md`（44 KB）挤掉，静默失效。

本插件走宿主的 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`，**不占 AGENTS.md 预算**，因此不会被挤掉。

## 两个通道

| 通道 | 内容 | 何时在上下文里 |
|---|---|---|
| **常驻段落** `godot:workflow` | `.dsh/prompt/core.md`（~3 KB）：五条铁律 + 流程骨架 + 崩溃级硬约束 | 每个会话，始终在 |
| **技能** `godot-workflow` | `.dsh/skills/godot-workflow/SKILL.md`（~9.7 KB）：完整流程细则、硬约束全表、四类模板 | 按需 —— agent 用 `skill` 工具加载 |

排序锚点取 `systemPrompt.getSectionOrder("PLAN_POLICY") + 10`（=510），
排在 `PLAN_POLICY`(500) 之后、`TEAM_POLICY`(600) 之前；取不到锚点时回落 550。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/home/atlaslinux/PluginManager/dsh-godot-workflow
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 godot-workflow   # 应看到 id: godot-workflow
```

`link:` 意味着改动源码即时生效，无需重新安装；但**插件内容在激活时读定**，
改 `.md` 后需要重启 `dsh web` 才会重新注入。

## 自检

```sh
node scripts/verify.mjs
node scripts/verify.mjs --against ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md   # 额外做正文漂移比对
```

31 项检查：文件在位、常驻核心体量与关键词、技能 frontmatter、入口导出、
补丁接线、以及与源 AGENTS.md 的行数/字数漂移。

## 修改内容

- `lib/index.js` —— 注册逻辑（零 npm 依赖，只用 Node 内置模块）
- `.dsh/prompt/core.md` —— 常驻核心，**改这里就是改每个会话的默认行为**
- `.dsh/skills/godot-workflow/SKILL.md` —— 完整版；由 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 转换而来
- `scripts/verify.mjs` —— 自检

## 已知边界

- **异常不抛错**：DSH 启动是全有全无，一个插件激活失败会拖死整个 harness。
  因此本插件在文件缺失/损坏时只记 `error` 日志并降级（跳过该项），
  完整性由 `scripts/verify.mjs` 在安装/开发阶段把关。
- **不做**决策日志同步、回退件 `--check`、`godot_ping` 门禁 —— 这些仍由各工程里的
  `tools/` 脚本承担。
- 常驻核心实际 **3038 B**，比设计目标 ~2 KB 大；见 README 的"为什么"一节权衡说明。

## 回退

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-godot-workflow
```

这只是卸载插件，不动 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`（本轮刻意未改它）。

plugins.description: DSH 右侧边栏的移动设备面板：把 mobilecli 封装成实时画面 + 直接操作，一套 API 同时覆盖 iOS 与 Android，并把 mobilecli 自带的 skill 一并注册给模型。A mobile device panel for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — wraps mobilecli as a live screen with direct interaction, one API for iOS and Android, plus the bundled mobilecli skill registered for the model.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-mobile **把手机装进 DSH 的右侧边栏 —— 实时画面 + 直接点击，一套 API 同时覆盖 iOS 与 Android** [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2%20实测-4c6ef5)](#) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm%20test-43%20passed-2ea043)](#自测) [![runtime deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/运行时依赖-0-8a8f99)](#它怎么做)
--- `mobilecli` 是一条覆盖 iOS 与 Android 的设备控制 CLI，但它的 `screencapture` 只能写到 stdout、没有面板。本插件把它封进 DSH 的右侧边栏，并把能力同时开放给人和模型。 - 📺 **实时画面**：Android 走 AVC/H.264（实测 **104fps**），iOS 模拟器走 MJPEG（实测 **131fps**） - 👆 **直接在画面上操作**：点击即点击、拖拽即滑动，等比例换算回设备坐标 - 🧰 **11 个模型工具**：读 UI 树、按标识点元素、读日志、等文本出现、**把面板打开给你看** - 📱 **一套 API 两端通用**：真机、模拟器、模拟机走同一条路径，没有平台分支 - 🎓 **自带 mobilecli 的 skill**：把上游 playbook 打包注册给模型，不用自己往 `.agents/` 抄 - 🔐 **浏览器从不接触设备端口**：只经 DSH 自己的 web 源，签名令牌 + loopback 围栏 - 📦 **零运行时依赖**：`react` 用宿主那份；客户端源码是 JSX，但**产物已提交**，安装方无需工具链（见[开发与自测](#开发与自测)） **目录**：[它解决什么问题](#它解决什么问题) · [安装](#安装) · [配置](#配置) · [使用](#使用) · [安全模型](#安全模型) · [已知边界](#已知边界) · [更多文档](#更多文档) · [License](#license) ## 它解决什么问题 DSH 社区已有一个 Android 插件和一个 iOS 插件，但各自踩了一个性能坑： | 方案 | 取帧方式 | 实测帧率 | |---|---|---| | `dsh-android` | `adb exec-out screencap` 循环（PNG） | **~1.8fps** | | `dsh-ios` | serve-sim MJPEG | 与下同量级 | | **本插件（Android）** | mobilecli AVC / H.264（MediaCodec 硬编） | **104fps** | | **本插件（iOS 模拟器）** | mobilecli MJPEG | **131fps** | 瓶颈不在 adb，而在**每帧搬一张完整 PNG**：1080p PNG 每帧几百 KB，H.264 每帧几 KB，差两个数量级。mobilecli 在设备端用 MediaCodec 编码，只把压缩后的码流传回来。 ### ⚠️ Flutter 应用读元素会读不到，这是预期的 Flutter 把整个 UI 画进一块不透明的原生 view，**无障碍树只能看到应用主动投影出去的那部分**。实测一个真实的 Flutter 应用（debug 构建）： ``` mobilecli dump ui --format json → 69 个节点，全部是 android.* 其中 32 个是 systemui 状态栏（时间/网速/wifi/电池），与你的应用无关 应用窗口下全是匿名 View / ImageView —— 只有 rect，没有 text、没有 identifier ``` 更深一层：Flutter 的**语义树默认根本不生成**（框架出于性能考虑，只在检测到读屏类辅助技术时才生成）。所以这不是 mobilecli 的缺陷，是 Flutter 的渲染模型决定的 —— 关掉读屏时 `ext.flutter.debugDumpSemanticsTreeInTraversalOrder` 会明确回你： > Semantics not generated … the framework only generates semantics when asked to do so by the platform. 要读**真正的 widget 树**必须走 Dart VM Service，或在 Flutter 工程里跑 `integration_test` / Patrol。两条路线的完整实测（协议细节、踩坑、阻塞项）见 **[docs/FLUTTER-TREE-RESEARCH.md](docs/FLUTTER-TREE-RESEARCH.md)**。 本插件**不提供**这个能力 —— 早先的 `mobile_flutter_tree` 只是个空承诺（它与 `mobile_ui_tree` 调同一个函数，却声称直连 VM Service），已删除。 ## 安装 ### 前置：mobilecli ```bash npm install -g mobilecli@latest mobilecli devices # 确认能看到设备 ``` ### 前置：adb（Android 必需） **Android 设备必须装 adb** —— mobilecli 不自己实现 adb 协议，它调用外部 `adb`。 而 **adb 缺失时 mobilecli 不报错**： ```json {"status":"ok","data":{"devices":[]}} // exit code 0，完全看不出问题 ``` 真相只在 daemon 日志里：`Failed running 'adb devices', is ANDROID_HOME set correctly?`。 所以手机明明插着、驱动也正常，设备列表却是空的 —— 大概率就是缺 adb。 ```bash # 1) 下载 platform-tools # https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools # 2) 让 adb 可被找到：加进 PATH，或设 ANDROID_HOME 指向 platform-tools 的**上一级** # 3) 重启 DSH，然后让 daemon 重新读取环境 mobilecli daemon stop ``` > ⚠️ **两个都会踩的坑** > > **① 环境变量是"启动时快照"。** 装完 adb 后**必须重启 DSH** —— 已运行的进程 > 看不到新写的 PATH / ANDROID_HOME。插件会区分这两种情况：确认 adb 装了但当前 > 进程看不到时，提示的是"重启 DSH"而不是"去装 adb"。 > > **② daemon 也会缓存环境。** mobilecli 的 daemon 是常驻进程，继承**启动那一刻** > 的环境。所以即使 DSH 的环境对了，旧的 daemon 仍会报"没有设备" —— 必须 > `mobilecli daemon stop`（或等它空闲 30 分钟自动退出）。 面板在"一台设备都没有"时会显示一条可照做的诊断（含 adb 路径与下一条动作）， 而不是只显示"未发现设备"。 iOS 真机还需要在设备上装 agent（**本插件不会自动装**）： ```bash mobilecli agent status --device mobilecli agent install --device # 真机需要 provisioning profile ``` iOS 模拟器同样需要装一次 agent，否则取流会报 `agent is not installed`。 ### 装插件 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @j62268781-alt/dsh-sidebar-mobile@latest dsh web ``` 或作为已有 profile 包的依赖： ```bash pnpm add @j62268781-alt/dsh-sidebar-mobile ``` 装完刷新页面，右侧边栏的「开始」页出现「移动设备」入口，点它打开面板。 也可以直接按快捷键（胶囊右侧会显示对应徽标）： | 环境 | 键位 | |---|---| | 桌面应用 | `⌘⇧M`（Windows/Linux 为 `Ctrl+Shift+M`）| | 浏览器 | `⌘⌥M`（Windows 为 `Ctrl+Alt+M`）| > 桌面端**没有**用 `⌘M`：macOS 把 `⌘M` 绑给了系统「最小化」，原生菜单会先吃掉这个键。 > 键位可在 **设置 → 快捷键** 里改；与 DSH 自带的 8 条绑定均无冲突（已按宿主自身的 > 绑定规则校验过保留键与重叠）。 > **它是「开始」页的第 5 个胶囊（官方 3 个 + `dsh-context` 1 个）**。DSH 的「开始」页有条硬规则： > 胶囊超过 4 个，就关掉**所有**胶囊的副标题（`MAX_DESCRIBED_ENTRIES = 4`，不是只关第 5 个）。 > 所以装上本插件后，「工作区文件 / 上下文 / 新建终端 / 浏览器」的副标题会一起消失—— > 这是上游的取舍，插件侧无法只为自己豁免。要恢复副标题，只能把入口挪到会话标题栏 > （`conversation.session.header.utilities`），而不是改本插件的 `description`。 > **桌面版**：`desktop` profile 由桌面应用独占，宿主 CLI 的 `dsh plugin --profile desktop` 会被拒绝。桌面端请走 **设置 → 插件市场**。 ## 配置 全部配置在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，挂在 `dsh-sidebar-mobile` 这一行下： | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关。关掉后插件仍加载，但不挂路由、不注册工具与技能 | | `binaryPath` | `null` | mobilecli 路径。`null` 走四级自动解析（见下） | | `homeDir` | `null` | `MOBILECLI_HOME`。`null` 用 mobilecli 默认的 `~/.mobilecli` | | `routePrefix` | `/_dsh/dsh-sidebar-mobile` | 路由前缀 | | `registerSkills` | `true` | 是否把 mobilecli 的 skill 注册给模型 | | `stream.idleStopSeconds` | `300` | 无消费者后多久停流 | | `stream.restartDelayMs` | `5000` | 流崩溃后的重启延迟 | | `stream.defaultScale` | `1.0` | 缩放。`0.5` 在 iOS 上实测 104fps/6.6Mbps（全分辨率 131fps/20.6Mbps） | | `useDaemonRpc` | `true` | 交互指令优先走 mobilecli daemon 的 unix socket（实测 `io tap` 7.3ms，CLI 是 104.2ms）。排查时设 `false` 强制走 CLI | | `trustedAuthorities` | `[]` | 经反向代理访问时显式列出对外 authority | `binaryPath` 为 `null` 时的**四级解析**顺序： 1. `MOBILECLI_PATH` 环境变量 2. `PATH` 上的 `mobilecli`（`npm -g` 装的 shim） 3. 本包 `node_modules` 里的平台包（`@mobilenext/mobilecli--`） 4. 全落空 → 工具仍注册，调用时给出安装提示（而不是插件加载失败） ## 使用 ### 面板 右侧边栏 →「移动设备」： - **设备下拉**：按类型**分组**（真机 / 模拟器），每项形如 `一加 12 · 真机`；离线再加「（离线）」。类型来自 mobilecli 的 `type` 字段（`real` / `simulator` / `emulator`），认不出的值原样显示而不猜 —— 实测同时插着真机和模拟器时，只显示名字**完全分不出哪个是模拟器** - **点一个离线模拟器会先把它启动起来**（冷启动可达数分钟，期间显示启动提示，别以为卡死了）。离线**真机**只选中、不启动 —— 真机不归 adb 启动。启动失败不影响选中，但会如实报错，不会让你对着黑屏猜 - **⌂ / ◁ / ⟳**：主屏幕 / 返回（仅 Android）/ 旋转 - **⟲**：重新申请令牌并重连（画面卡住时用） - **▢ / ▣ / ▤**：切换外观（边框 / 真机 / 无框） - **在画面上点击** → 点设备的对应位置；**拖拽** → 滑动 - **模型也能替你打开这个面板**（`mobile_open_panel`）。⚠️ 它**不是给模型读界面用的** —— 面板在浏览器里、不在模型上下文里。用途是需要你**亲眼看**屏幕时把它推到你面前 状态栏显示 `实时/未串流`、平台、以及实际拿到的流格式（`H.264` 或 `MJPEG`）。 ### 模型工具 只注册 **11 个**「工具能做得比 CLI 更好」的工具： | 工具 | 用途 | |---|---| | `mobile_devices` | 列出所有设备（**先跑这个**拿到 device id） | | `mobile_boot` | 启动设备并开始串流（画面出现在面板） | | `mobile_ui_tree` | **读界面首选**：类型、文本、identifier、坐标 | | `mobile_screenshot` | 截图（给人或多模态模型看，不是读界面的首选） | | `mobile_tap_element` | **按标识/文本点元素**（比坐标稳，可带 `expect_text` 一并验证） | | `mobile_list_apps` | 列已安装应用（启动前先列，别猜包名） | | `mobile_find_text` / `mobile_tap_text` | OCR 找文字 / 点文字（树读不到时的兜底） | | `mobile_wait_for` | 等文本出现或消失 | | `mobile_logs` | 读设备日志（logcat / unified log） | | `mobile_open_panel` | **把侧边栏的移动设备面板打开给用户看**（跨进程，需要客户端在跑） | #### 为什么不给 tap / swipe / 输入 / 按键 / 启动应用注册工具 这 5 个曾是工具，但只是 `mobilecli` 的薄包装（一次 `runJson` 加一句 `return`）， 没有任何加工 —— 而 agent 本来就有 shell，直接跑等价命令即可： ```bash mobilecli io tap --device 540,1200 mobilecli io swipe --device --duration 250 540,1800,540,700 mobilecli io text --device "hello" mobilecli io button --device BACK mobilecli apps launch --device com.example.app ``` 这 5 个的 schema 每次请求都要发 —— **删掉它们实测省 453 tokens/轮** （16 个 = 1487 → 11 个 = 1034）。 > 此后又删了 `mobile_flutter_tree`（与 `mobile_ui_tree` 重复）， > 并加了 `mobile_open_panel`。**当前是 11 个 = 964 tokens/轮** —— > 数的个数一样，但不是同一批工具，别把这个差值和上面的 453 混起来。 ⚠️ 关键细节没跟着删，都在 skill 的「Driving the device from the shell」一节： 坐标是**物理像素**、`io swipe` **必须传 `--duration`**（否则默认 1000ms 慢动作）、 输入前必须**先聚焦**、`io button` 的键名、启动前先列应用。 被删的名字留在 `REMOVED_TOOL_NAMES` 里，便于分辨「插件删了它」和「名字打错了」。 工具描述里写明了"先用哪个、什么时候升级到下一个"，因为三种观察方式的代价差一个数量级： ``` mobile_ui_tree ~100–300ms 结构化，首选 mobile_screenshot ~200–400ms 给人看 mobile_find_text ~1s OCR，兜底 ``` ### 自带 skill mobilecli 仓库里的 playbook（`SKILL.md` + `reference.md`）被原样打包并注册，模型可以直接读到命令的完整用法、平台差异、以及一批踩坑记录。**不需要你往 `.agents/` 里抄一份。** ## 安全模型 **浏览器从不接触 mobilecli 的端口**（它监听 localhost 且没有鉴权）。所有字节只经 DSH 自己的 web 源： ``` → 围栏校验 → Host 转发到 mobilecli → 回传 ``` 两道闸门，**顺序不可颠倒**： 1. **传输层围栏（先）**：对端必须是 loopback（TCP 层事实，客户端伪造不了）；`Host` 头必须是 loopback 或显式配置的 `trustedAuthorities`。`Host` 与 `Origin` 是客户端可控数据，这里只用它们**否决**，从不用来授权。 2. **capability（后）**：HMAC-SHA256 签名，10 分钟过期。`deviceId` 参与签名，所以给 A 设备签的令牌拿到 B 上

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: unified Skills + MCP manager with hot-reload enable/disable and Git-based skill install/update.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-mcp-tool

[![Listed on DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool)
[![version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool?label=version&color=2ea44f)](https://github.com/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool?color=2ea44f)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.15%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-2ea44f)](package.json)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that puts **Skills and MCP servers under one roof**, reachable from both the settings menu and a main-interface sidebar entry — with **hot-reload enable/disable toggles** and **Git-based skill install/update**.

## Features

**Two entry points, one panel**

- Settings menu → "技能与 MCP" / "Skills & MCP" page.
- Main interface → a sidebar icon row that opens the same panel in the centre column.

Both render the identical component, so the four tabs (Skills / MCP / Remote sources / Backup) behave the same wherever you open them.

**Layout: the two entry points are handled separately**

The host's layout contract differs between the centre panel and the settings page, so the shell has two modes selected by `data-surface`:

- **Centre panel (opened from the sidebar icon)**: the host supplies neither padding nor a scroll container, so the plugin provides both — centred content with breathing room (up to 48px per side, shrinking responsively on narrow windows) plus its own scrolling.
- **Settings page**: the host already renders the section inside its content column (padding and scrolling included), so the plugin adds nothing on top — no doubled inset, no nested scrollbars.

**Scrolling: long skill lists stay reachable, with no visible scrollbar**

In the centre panel only the list scrolls while **the title and tabs stay pinned to the top**, so the refresh button and tab strip remain reachable even at the bottom of a long list, with breathing room after the last row.

**No visible scrollbar at all**: the wheel, trackpad, touch, and keyboard (arrow keys / PageUp / PageDown) all keep working — only the bar is no longer drawn. The horizontal insets therefore *always* equal the inner padding: symmetric left and right regardless of content length or whether scrolling is needed, with no sideways jump when a scrollbar would have appeared or disappeared. The same rules cover modals, so long forms still scroll.

`scrollbar-gutter: stable` is deliberately *not* used: it reserves scrollbar width even when the content fits (measured: `stable` 15px, `stable both-edges` 30px), leaving an empty band on a page that has nothing to scroll. All three hiding mechanisms are declared — `scrollbar-width`, `-ms-overflow-style`, and `::-webkit-scrollbar` — so no browser falls back to a native bar that would skew the insets.

**Ordering: alphabetical, always**

List order is **predictable**, so you never have to hunt through entries:

- **Skills**: grouped by source, with a fixed group order of **project → user → plugin → other** (it does not shift as skills come and go, so group headings stay put); **alphabetical by name within each group**.
- **MCP servers**: managed and external rows are each sorted alphabetically by server name.
- **Remote sources**: sorted alphabetically by repository label.
- Sorting is **case-insensitive**: `Chrome_DevTools_MCP` sorts before `REA`, instead of all uppercase names clumping at the top. Only when two names are identical in lowercase does the raw string break the tie, keeping the order stable.
- Managed rows are written to `cordis.patch.yml` in that same order, so the file and the UI never disagree.
- Ordering is applied at the single choke point every write path goes through, so add/edit/enable/disable/delete can't bypass it.

**Skills**

- Lists every skill from all four standard roots, in official rank order: project `.dsh/skills` (100) → project `.agents/skills` (200) → user `~/.dsh/skills` (400) → user `~/.agents/skills` (500).
- Handles both layouts: directory bundles (`<name>/SKILL.md`) and flat files (`<name>.md`), plus nested/categorised trees.
- **Enable/disable is a lossless rename**: `SKILL.md` ⇄ `SKILL.md.disabled` (or `<name>.md` ⇄ `<name>.md.disabled`). The official provider only recognises the exact filenames, so the skill leaves the catalog while its files and `references/`, `scripts/`, `assets/` stay fully intact. The provider's watcher picks the change up on the next catalog refresh — **no restart**.
- Malformed skills stay listed but flagged **格式不合规 / Invalid format**, so you can fix or delete them rather than being unable to see them.
- Plugin-registered skills (no file on disk) are listed read-only.
- Create, edit, and delete skills through the built-in editor; frontmatter is validated before anything touches disk.
- **Install / update from Git**: shallow-clone a repository (or a subdirectory of one), discover every valid skill inside, and copy it to the chosen root. Records the source so you can re-pull later; `git ls-remote` tells you whether an update exists.
- **Junk directories are filtered out on write**: `.git`, `.hg`, `.svn`, `node_modules`, `__pycache__`, `.venv` and friends never land in the skill directory. When the repository root *is* the skill bundle (a `SKILL.md` at the top level), the clone's `.git` would otherwise be copied wholesale — worth several MB of commit history and remote URLs. The UI lists exactly what was skipped.
- **Type `/` in a session to pick a skill**: this plugin registers the skills it manages into DSH's skill registry, so the `/` menu matches and invokes them directly. A skill marked `disable-model-invocation: true` appears *only* there (the model never sees it), and a skill shown as disabled in the UI never appears in `/`. Changes take effect immediately — no restart.

  > Why this plugin supplies its own provider: the host-level `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` row is deliberately disabled by the web app (its comment reads “presets own local discovery”), leaving each agent preset to mount its own. On some presets that provider does not actually take effect — skills on disk then appear neither in `/` nor to the model. This plugin does not depend on the preset being correct; it registers the roots it manages itself.

**Proxy: a Git proxy field above the tabs**

On many networks a direct `git clone` of a repository times out, which makes installing and updating skills impossible. A **proxy bar sits above the four tabs** — it is a prerequisite shared by every Git operation in every tab (install, update, check for updates), not a setting belonging to one of them.

- **Command-scoped, never global.** The address is injected as `git -c http.proxy=… -c https.proxy=… <subcommand>`. **Your global git config is never rewritten** — try `git config --global --get http.proxy` before and after; it is untouched. The plugin only adds flags to its own calls.
- **Off means "leave it alone", not "clear it".** With the switch off, no `-c` flags are added at all, so git falls back to whatever you configured globally (direct, or your own `git config` proxy). A `git p-on`-style global setting keeps working.
- **One Test button answers "is it the network or the repo?"** It probes the remote twice — once through the proxy and once direct — and reports both, so you can see at a glance which path is broken. If git isn't installed at all, the install dialog says so separately.
- **Credentials are treated as secrets.** A URL like `http://user:pass@host:port` has its password masked (`http://user:***@host:port`) everywhere it is sent to the browser, and is **omitted from exported bundles unless you tick "Include MCP secrets"**. The field echoes the masked form; saving it unchanged, or editing only the host/port, **keeps the stored password** rather than clearing it. If a bundle carries a masked password and this machine has none, the import plan says so instead of writing an empty one that would fail confusingly later.
- **Supported schemes**: `http`, `https`, `socks4`, `socks4a`, `socks5`, `socks5h`. A blank or malformed add

plugins.description: Native Telegram bridge for Paean Harness (DeepSeek Harness distribution): chat with your agent and drive sessions, models, workspaces and goals from your phone. Also works with other DSH profiles.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Paean Telegram

A native **Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**, built so the **Paean Harness
distribution** — which ships no Telegram bridge of its own — can be driven from a phone. Send a
message and the agent answers in the chat; everything else (sessions, models, workspaces, goals,
skills, plugins, host files) is one tap away on a persistent button bar.

There is **no server to run**: the plugin mounts inside the Harness Host process and talks to
the Telegram Bot API directly over long polling.

| | |
|---|---|
| Package name | `dsh-telegram` (kept unchanged: profile installs reference it) |
| Version | `0.4.0` |
| Requires | Node.js >= 22, a DSH profile (tested on Harness `0.1.0-rc.21` with `@deepseek-ai/*` `0.2.1-alpha.1`) |
| Runtime dependency | `grammy` |
| License | MIT (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)) |

> **This repository is a fork.** It is based on
> [xqicxx/dsh-telegram](https://github.com/xqicxx/dsh-telegram) (MIT) and keeps the original
> license and copyright notice. This build adds **runtime-compatibility work for the dsh 0.2.x
> host APIs** — see [Local changes in this build](#local-changes-in-this-build).
>
> **English only.** The documentation, the bot's button labels, cards, receipts and log lines are
> all English.
>
> **Primary target: Paean Harness.** The Paean Harness distribution ships no Telegram bridge;
> this repository exists to fill that gap. It is developed and tested on Paean Harness
> `0.1.0-rc.21` (`@paean-ai/harness`) with `@deepseek-ai/*` `0.2.1-alpha.1` — the combination on
> which the upstream plugin fails, see [Paean Harness](#paean-harness) and
> [Runtime compatibility](#runtime-compatibility).
>
> **Other DSH profiles: best effort, and welcome.** Nothing in the code is Paean-specific — it
> needs only Node.js >= 22 and the `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer packages — so any DSH profile running
> `0.1.1-rc.2` through `0.2.x` should mount it, and the seam layer accepts both generations.
> Builds outside that window are untested.

---

## Table of contents

- [What you get](#what-you-get)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Paean Harness](#paean-harness)
- [Install into a DSH profile](#install-into-a-dsh-profile)
- [Bot token](#bot-token)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Chat roster (who may talk to the bot)](#chat-roster-who-may-talk-to-the-bot)
- [Commands](#commands)
- [Button bar](#button-bar)
- [Cards](#cards)
- [Agent tools](#agent-tools)
- [Media and attachments](#media-and-attachments)
- [Approvals and questions](#approvals-and-questions)
- [Auto-compaction and long-task notifications](#auto-compaction-and-long-task-notifications)
- [Security model](#security-model)
- [Runtime compatibility](#runtime-compatibility)
- [Development](#development)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Local changes in this build](#local-changes-in-this-build)
- [Credits and license](#credits-and-license)

---

## What you get

- **Chat with the agent**: any text you send becomes a turn for that chat's bound session.
  Streaming reasoning and tool calls appear in one message edited in place.
- **Full harness control from the phone**: sessions (list / resume / fork / rename / archive),
  models and reasoning effort, workspaces and the active project folder, goals, todos, the
  agent inbox queue, skills, subagents, agent presets, installed plugins, credentials
  (descriptions only), host settings, background jobs, host file browsing, session history.
- **Turn receipts and live status**: a one-line receipt after each turn (turns, steps, tool
  calls, tokens, cache-hit rate) and a status card that keeps refreshing while work runs.
- **Agent tools**: the agent can send you messages and files back through the same bridge.

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. get the code
git clone https://github.com/SMMURDA/dsh-paean-telegram.git
cd dsh-paean-telegram

# 2. OPTIONAL rebuild — dist/ is committed, so this is only needed after source edits
npm ci && npm run build

# 3. install it into your DSH profile (see the next section)
# 4. create <workspace>/.pi/telegram.json with your chat id (see Configuration)
# 5. export the bot token, restart the harness, then send /start to your bot
```

## Paean Harness

**Paean Harness** is a packaged DSH distribution (`@paean-ai/harness`) that runs a Harness process
from a supervised launcher, with profiles under `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>` — for example the `web`
profile that serves the Harness Web UI. It ships **no Telegram bridge**, so this plugin is
maintained to fill exactly that gap.

### Why the upstream plugin fails on Paean

Paean's runtime bundles `@deepseek-ai/*` **0.2.1-alpha.1**, while the upstream plugin is written
against the **0.1.1-rc.2** seams. Two concrete consequences:

1. the plugin's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer ranges (`^0.1.1-rc.2`) do not match the running dsh
   version, so the install is refused unless an exact-version exemption is granted; and
2. once forced in, session reads break — `Session.events` is a *method* on 0.2.x, and iterating it
   throws `session.events is not iterable`, so the Sessions card cannot load.

This build removes both barriers: the peer ranges span `>=0.1.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`, and the session
seams read whichever shape the host exposes.

### Paean install recipe

```bash
git clone https://github.com/SMMURDA/dsh-paean-telegram.git
cd dsh-paean-telegram
# dist/ is committed, so this is optional unless you changed the source
npm ci && npm run build
```

1. Install it into the profile that runs your Paean Harness process (`web` in the default Paean
   setup) — see [Install into a DSH profile](#install-into-a-dsh-profile).
2. Create `<workspace>/.pi/telegram.json` with your chat id:

   ```json
   { "security": { "allowedChatIds": [123456789] }, "watch": { "autoStart": true } }
   ```

3. Give the process a token: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` in its environment, or a `chmod 600`
   `.telegram-token` beside the package.
4. Restart the Harness process. A Paean launcher is supervised, so it comes back on its own; the
   Web UI and the bot are unavailable for a few seconds.
5. Send `/start` to your bot.

### Compatibility matrix

| Environment | `@deepseek-ai/*` | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Paean Harness `0.1.0-rc.21` | `0.2.1-alpha.1` | **Primary target — verified live** |
| Other DSH profiles | `0.1.1-rc.2` | Supported (legacy seams) |
| Other DSH profiles | `0.2.x` | Best effort — same seams as Paean |
| DSH `0.3.x` and later | — | Untested; seam work may be needed |

## Install into a DSH profile

A DSH **profile** decides which plugins a Harness process loads. Pick either path.

### Path A — `plugin_manager` (recommended)

1. Clone this repository somewhere permanent.
2. Optionally `npm ci && npm run build` (the committed `dist/` already runs).
3. In a DSH session, install the bundle from the **absolute** directory:

   ```
   plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "/abs/path/to/dsh-paean-telegram")
   ```

   The bundle patch shipped at [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml) mounts the plugin:

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: telegram
         name: dsh-telegram
   ```

4. Restart the harness if your profile is a startup profile.

### Path B — manual profile wiring

Used by this deployment, and handy when you want to hack on the source in place.

1. Make the profile depend on the directory (a symlink install, so edits are live after a
   harness restart):

   ```jsonc
   // ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "dsh-telegram": "link:/abs/path/to/dsh-paean-telegram"
     }
   }
   ```

   DSH enforces plugin/runtime compatibility by checking every `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer range
   against the running dsh version, and it records an **exact-version exemption** in
   `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/compatibility.json` only when a peer range does *not* match, for
   example:

   ```json
   { "dsh-telegram@0.4.0": ["0.2.1-alpha.1"] }
   ```

   This fork's peer ranges (`>=0.1.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`) cover both the 0.1.x and 0.2.x generations, so
   a matching exemption is normally **not** needed. An exemption recorded earlier for an older
   build simply becomes unused; you can leave it or delete it.

2. Add the plugin row to the profil

plugins.description: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize or true fullscreen on launch, minimize, keep the window always on top, and quit with a native confirmation dialog (Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-window-control

**English** · [中文正文见下方](#中文文档)

## English

Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for
you. **Self-contained**: after install, the plugin's host half opens DSH's window channel by
itself — no extra script, no Python, and no manual file editing.

**What it does**

| Capability | Notes |
|---|---|
| Master switch | On by default. Turned off, the plugin has no effect at all (no auto-fill, no shortcut quits, all other controls hidden) and it reverts the window state it changed |
| Fullscreen / leave fullscreen | True window fullscreen (covers the taskbar), not a web-level fullscreen |
| Maximize / restore | Maximizes and restores the window |
| Minimize | Sends the window to the taskbar |
| Always on top | Keeps DSH above other windows |
| Quit DeepSeek Harness | Always shows a **native confirmation dialog** first |
| Fill the screen on launch | Three choices: **maximize (default)** / true fullscreen / off. Applies immediately, no restart |
| Quit shortcut | Four choices: **Esc (default)** / double Esc / Ctrl+Q / off |
| Leave fullscreen with Esc | On by default. In true fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen instead of asking to quit |

Entry point: **Settings → Window & Quit**.

**Install**

1. Add the plugin (replace the profile name to match your setup):

   ```
   dsh plugin add dsh-window-control
   ```

2. Quit DSH completely - right-click the tray icon and choose Quit. Closing the window only
   hides it to the tray, which is not a quit and the bridge will not be touched.
3. Reopen DSH (first launch) - this launch installs the window channel. The Settings -> Window &
   Quit page will say the channel is not active yet; **that is expected, not a failure**.
4. Quit DSH completely again and reopen it (second launch) - this launch reads the channel.
   Open Settings -> Window & Quit: the warning is gone and every button works. No more restarts
   are needed after this.

> ⚠️ **Why two restarts?** The DSH main process loads its code at launch, and the plugin can only
> patch the window channel while DSH is already running — so the first launch installs the channel
> and the second launch is the one that reads it. Quit DSH completely (tray icon → Quit; closing
> the window only hides it to the tray) between the two launches.

**Why it touches the host.** The DSH main process exposes no IPC channel for maximize,
minimize, always-on-top or quit — the stock `app.asar` handles none of them, and the main
window hides to the tray on close. The plugin therefore injects a small set of IPC channels
into `resources/app.asar` once (equal-length replacement, archive size unchanged, integrity
hash recomputed, backup kept as `app.asar.orig`). This is the same approach other DSH plugins
that need host behaviour take. See the Chinese section *「窗口通道是怎么装上去的」* for the
byte budget, upgrade and safety details.

**Cross-platform.** Windows (user-level install) is tested and working. On Windows under
`Program Files` the first install needs one elevated run. On macOS, modifying `app.asar` can
invalidate code signing — the plugin tells you if that happens and `restore` reverts it. On
Linux it works but with fewer path fallbacks. The archive is located by deriving the install
directory from the running DSH executable, so custom install paths are supported.

**Manual commands** (troubleshooting)

```
node lib/bridge-cli.mjs status      # is the channel installed?
node lib/bridge-cli.mjs install     # install it (add --force to reinstall)
node lib/bridge-cli.mjs restore     # put the original app.asar back
node lib/bridge-cli.mjs uninstall   # remove the channel and clean up
```

**Uninstall.** Clean uninstall is always two steps: revert the bridge **first**, then remove the
plugin - order matters.

> Why it cannot be automatic: once the plugin is removed from the profile, its host half is no
> longer loaded, so no code runs again - there is no "next launch discovers the bridge is still
> there and reverts it" opportunity. That is a hard limit of the DSH plugin model.

**Path A - command line (cleanest, recommended)**

1. Quit DSH completely.
2. Revert the bridge and clear the backup: `node lib/bridge-cli.mjs uninstall`.
3. Remove the plugin: `dsh plugin remove dsh-window-control`.

**Path B - no command line**

1. Add `config: { autoInstall: false }` for this plugin in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
2. Quit DSH completely and reopen once - the host half reverts the bridge and clears the backup.
3. Once DSH is back to stock, remove the plugin from the profile.

To just revert without removing, use `node lib/bridge-cli.mjs restore` - it keeps the
`app.asar.orig` backup (use this if you plan to reinstall later). Leaving the bridge in place and
only removing the plugin also "works" - it becomes dead code - and DSH's next auto-update
replaces `app.asar` entirely, which removes it.

**Testing scope.** This plugin has only been exercised on the author's own Windows machine
running DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2. Other operating systems, DSH versions, or
environments are unverified - it may or may not behave the same there.

**Bug reports.** If something misbehaves on your setup, please open an issue at
https://github.com/YunLiZeMeng/dsh-window-control/issues - include your OS, DSH version,
and steps to reproduce.

**Self-tests** (both run against mocks; neither touches your DSH install)

```
node _selftest.mjs          # browser half, 76 checks
node _bridge-selftest.mjs   # bridge engine, 48 checks, uses a tiny fake archive
```

MIT licensed. The rest of this document is in Chinese and goes into more depth.

---

## 中文文档

如果你嫌每次打开 Harness 都要手动全屏，这个插件可以帮你自动铺满。**自包含**：装好之后
由插件自己在后台一次性打通 DSH 的窗口通道，不需要额外脚本、不需要 Python、也不需要你手动改任何文件。

### 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **插件总开关** | 置顶开关，**默认开**。关闭后本插件不产生任何效果（不自动铺满、快捷键不退出、其余控件全部隐藏），行为等同「未安装本插件」；同时会撤回它自己改过的窗口状态（含置顶），不影响你手动调过的窗口 |
| 全屏 / 退出全屏 | **真窗口全屏**（盖住任务栏），不是网页级全屏 |
| 最大化 / 还原 | 窗口最大化与还原 |
| **最小化** | 把窗口收进任务栏（v3 桥） |
| **窗口置顶** | 让 DSH 始终显示在其他窗口之上（v3 桥） |
| 退出 DeepSeek Harness | **无条件**先弹**原生确认对话框**，确认后才退出 |
| 启动时自动铺满窗口 | 三选一：**最大化（默认）** / 真全屏 / 不自动；改了立即生效，不用重启 |
| **退出快捷键** | 四选一：**Esc（默认）** / 双击 Esc / Ctrl+Q / 关闭。某些界面里 Esc 另有用途时，改成后两者可避免误触 |
| 按 Esc 退出全屏 | 开关，默认开；**真全屏下 Esc 先退出全屏**，不弹退出确认（否则全屏里没有可见出口）。此项始终认 Esc，与上面「退出快捷键」的取值无关 |

入口：**设置 → 窗口与退出**。

![窗口区：当前状态 / 最大化 / 最小化 / 窗口置顶 / 退出按钮](screenshots/settings-window.png)

![启动行为三选一与退出快捷键，含真全屏提示](screenshots/settings-startup.png)

### 安装

按下面四步走：

1. **安装插件**（在终端执行；按你的 DSH 配置把 `desktop` 换成实际 profile 名）：

   ```
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-window-control
   ```

2. **完全退出 DSH** —— 托盘图标右键 →「退出」。只关窗口只是把窗口隐藏到托盘，不算退出，桥不会被处理。

3. **重新打开 DSH（第 1 次启动）**：这次启动负责把窗口通道「装上」。此时打开「设置 → 窗口与退出」会看到「窗口通道尚未生效」的提示，**这是预期内的，不是装失败**。

4. **再次完全退出并重新打开 DSH（第 2 次启动）**：这次才真正「生效」。打开「设置 → 窗口与退出」，提示消失、所有按钮可用，安装完成。此后**不再需要重启**。

> **为什么必须重启两次**：DSH 主进程的代码在启动时就被载入内存，插件只能在 DSH 跑起来之后才能去装窗口通道，所以这一轮改动要等下次启动才被读到；而装插件本身也要重启一次插件才第一次运行。于是时间线是「装插件（未运行）→ 第 1 次启动（装上桥）→ 第 2 次启动（生效）」。

如果自动安装真的被挡住（装在 `Program Files` 没写权限、macOS 签名、杀软拦截、DSH 刚升级导致拒绝注入），插件不会让你一直空转重启：连续 3 次启动读不到通道时，设置页会列出具体原因、宿主诊断文件的位置和自查命令，还有一个「复制排障信息」按钮。手动排障命令见下方「手动操作（排障用）」。

> 宿主半边在每次 DSH 启动后都会检查一次：已经装好就什么都不做（幂等），所以 DSH 升级覆盖安装目录之后，**下一次启动会自动重新装好**，你不需要做任何事。打桥前它还会把 `app.asar.orig` 与当前归档核对一遍，对不上就重做备份 —— 这样备份永远对应你正在用的这一版。

### 插件总开关（「关闭 = 等同未安装」）

总开关是唯一的全局开关，它关掉后：

1. 启动不再自动铺满；
2. `Esc` 不再触发退出（监听器仍在，但直接返回）；
3. 设置区块只剩总开关本身 + 一行「插件已停用」提示，其余控件全部隐藏；
4. 如果本次会话的窗口状态是本插件自动改的，会一并退回普通窗口。

这些判断每次都重新读配置，所以**改开关立即生效，不需要重启**。

### 为什么必须改一次宿主（而不是像普通插件那样）

DSH 的插件体系有两半，两边都碰不到主进程：

- **宿主半边**（`lib/index.js`）跑在 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 的独立 Node 子进程里，
  整个宿主包里 `BrowserWindow` 出现 **0 次** —— 没有 Electron 能力。
- **渲染端半边**（`lib/client.js`）跑在 `dsh-app://app` 的沙箱页面里，只能调用 preload
  暴露出来的东西。

而对未打补丁的官方 `app.asar` 做过逐条测绘后，结论是渲染端**拿不到任何窗口控制能力**：

- `DESKTOP_IPC` 清单里确实有 `window-fullscreen`，但它**只被 `webContents.send()`
  单向推送**（在 `enter-full-screen` / `leave-full-screen` 时告诉页面去调整 40px 标题栏），
  **没有任何 `ipcMain.handle` 注册它** —— 页面只能「听」，不能「设」。
- 官方 `dshDesktop` 暴露出的 API 只有 `browser` / `deviceInfo` / `keyboard` /
  `shortcuts` / `updates`，**一条窗口控制都没有**。
- `windows-menu`（Windows 系统菜单）只认 `application` / `edit` 两种菜单（撤销、复

plugins.description: Single-client session tabs preserving native sidebars and background work
plugins.readme_text:
# 轻量会话标签 / dsh-session-tabs

单客户端会话标签，复用 DSH 原生聊天视图和任务服务，保留左右侧栏及底部工作台。无 iframe，无运行时依赖。

[English](README_EN.md) · 版本 0.1.6 · MIT

[![verify](https://github.com/QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs/actions/workflows/verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs/actions/workflows/verify.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-session-tabs.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-tabs)

![合成会话中的标签栏与面板按钮](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs/main/docs/assets/session-tabs.png)

## 当前状态

**0.1.6 修复了 0.1.5 中打开插件管理等全局页面时整个窗口卡死的问题，建议 0.1.5 用户更新。**

已针对 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** 验证，源代码采用 MIT 协议。DSH 的客户端 API 仍在演化，升级宿主后需要重新验收。

## 使用

- 原生左栏打开的会话自动加入顶部标签。点击标签切换，`＋` 使用原生新建会话。
- 当前标签与内容区使用同一亮色表面，通过两侧底部反向圆角衔接；其他标签在较暗背景上，悬停时标题和关闭按钮共用一块灰色底色。跟随 DSH 的亮/暗主题。
- `＋` 紧跟标签，与 `×` 图标居中对齐，旁边不再显示 `⋯`。底部工作区和右侧栏入口位于标签行右端，复用对应原生按钮的图标、状态和点击事件。右栏展开后，中央的打开入口隐藏，只保留窗口最右侧原生收起按钮；打开按钮采用相同的 28px 点击区域和 15px 图标。原生其他标题栏按钮保持原位。缺少原生入口时不显示对应按钮，切回原生视图或卸载时恢复原入口。
- 右栏开关位置在动画期间固定保留，底部按钮不会挤进来。收起时若原生打开入口尚未恢复，该位置暂时禁用；就绪后恢复点击。两个按钮均使用 28px 点击区域并居中对齐，底部图标沿用原生 16px。
- `×` 只关闭标签，不删除、归档或停止会话。运行或待确认的会话在后台保留，结束后释放额外引用。
- 左栏底部的「标签窗口」线条图标用于显示/隐藏标签，悬停显示目标视图名称。焦点在标签栏内时，`⌘/Ctrl + Shift + T` 可恢复本次打开窗口内刚关闭的标签；输入框不拦截此快捷键。
- 拖动调整顺序；标签获得焦点后，左右方向键切换，`Alt + Shift + 左/右` 调整顺序。输入框没有新增全局快捷键，中文组字不受拦截。
- `●` 运行中，`!` 等待确认，`✓` 完成未读，`…` 正在连接；空闲时不显示状态圆点。

关闭整个客户端、卸载插件与关闭标签是不同操作。原生任务的存续仍由宿主负责。不同会话同时修改同一文件的冲突也仍由宿主与用户处理。

## 安装与回退

### 从 npm 安装和下载（推荐）

npm 页面：[dsh-session-tabs](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-tabs)。建议先在独立 profile 试用。

**Desktop：**在应用内插件管理器添加 `dsh-session-tabs`。

**Web：**使用 DSH 命令安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6
```

如果使用 npm 手动管理 profile，先进入目标 profile 目录，再执行：

```sh
npm install dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6 --ignore-scripts
```

手动安装包后，还需在该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中启用 `dsh-session-tabs`，再刷新或重开 DSH；DSH 插件管理器和上面的 `dsh plugin` 命令会处理插件启用。

**只下载离线安装包：**在希望保存文件的目录运行：

```sh
npm pack dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6
```

会生成 `dsh-session-tabs-0.1.6.tgz`，可在 DSH 插件管理器中用该文件的完整路径添加。

### 从 GitHub 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs
```

CLI 的 `--profile desktop` 是保留名称，不能套用上述 Web 命令。已有本地安装的用户可在目标 profile 的包管理器更新为 `dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6`，再完全退出并重开应用。开发用的模拟模型和测试 profile 不包含在 npm 包中。

临时回退：点击左栏底部的视图切换图标。完整移除：在目标 profile 的插件管理器移除 `dsh-session-tabs`，再刷新客户端；注入节点、样式、订阅与会话引用会清理。浏览器本地标签清单仍保留，可在需要时清除该站点的 `dsh-session-tabs.v1` 键。

## 状态和性能

标签顺序、启用偏好及活动身份存于 `localStorage['dsh-session-tabs.v1']`。刷新恢复标签；失效/归档 ID 会剔除。不同窗口同步偏好与标签身份，但不会抢占另一个窗口的当前会话。

只有一棵原生聊天视图。重开客户端时，非活动标签只恢复身份，不立即加载全部历史。已经访问过的标签保留轻量会话绑定，以沿用原生草稿/附件状态；其数量仍会影响内存，因此本插件不承诺无限标签或固定内存开销。草稿沿用原生机制，本插件不提供跨重启草稿持久化保证。

标签节点按身份复用，点击后立即更新标签；后台状态通知合并更新，浏览器存储写入短暂合并。实际会话内容仍由宿主原生导航加载，不能保证所有开关操作即时完成。实际验证范围与兼容性边界见 [验收说明](docs/validation.md)。

中心挂载点使用稳定 `data-slot="main"`，没有专用的官方标签栏插槽；宿主结构变化是主要兼容性风险。原生 sidebar/rightbar 插槽和右栏服务没有被替换或代理。顶栏入口仅转发到仍留在原处的原生控件，不搬动 React 管理的节点。若挂载失败，回滚新增节点并保留原生界面。

## 开发与验收

开发本仓库时：

```sh
node --test test/verify.mjs
node tools/start-test-profile.mjs --runtime /absolute/path/to/installed/@deepseek-ai/dsh --port 3096
# 可选复用已安装的右栏插件：--better-sidebar /absolute/path/to/dsh-better-sidebar
```

测试数据、profile 和日志仅写入本仓库 `.tmp/`。测试模型 `Local delayed echo` 本地流式输出约 60 秒，无网络模型请求；需在界面中明确选择该模型后发送合成任务。它仅用于验证并发、关闭和取消隔离。

真实 GUI 冒烟：`node tools/real-ui-check.mjs --url-file /absolute/path/to/test-url.txt --out docs/real-ui.png`，URL 文件仅保存隔离服务启动时给出的本机认证 URL，不提交。连接自己启动的 Electron 验收副本可用 `--connect-port 9346 --target-match <observed-main-target>`。`--edge-ui-check` 检查右栏开关；配合 `--handoff-ui-check` 在上述合成会话中检查底部按钮规格、连续点击和动画期间的位置。范围见 [验收说明](docs/validation.md)。

源码不需要构建，`lib/client.js` 即真实客户端产物；`npm pack` 只包含生产插件和说明，不包含测试模型、日志、profile、桌面副本或截图。
